note: Approximate service-area mile ranges for grouping I-80 events only. These are NOT official NDOT boundary claims. District boundaries follow county lines; mile markers are a convenience for sorting events west to east. Source: NDOT divisions & districts page (https://dot.nebraska.gov/about/divisions-districts/) and district map (https://dot.nebraska.gov/media/23fp3ujl/districts-map-lines-color.png).

districts.label: Panhandle
districts.note: Wyoming line to roughly the Deuel/Keith county line (between Big Springs and Brule).

districts.label: West-central
districts.note: Deuel/Keith county line to roughly the Buffalo/Hall county line (near Shelton–Wood River).

districts.label: Grand Island–York
districts.note: Wood River area to roughly the York/Seward county line (east of Waco).

districts.label: Seward–Lincoln–Cass
districts.note: York/Seward county line to roughly the Cass/Sarpy county line (near Springfield).

districts.label: Omaha metro
districts.note: Springfield area to the Missouri River (I-80 end, mile ~454).
